description: Edit a text file of an app by pieces, without sending the whole file: a list of `edits`, each an `oldText` to find and the `newText` to put in its place (like your own editor). Each oldText must appear exactly once in the file (include a few lines around it to make it unique), or pass `replaceAll: true` to change every place it appears. The edits apply in order, each on the result of the ones before; if any fails, none is applied and the answer says which one and why. Pass `baseVersion` (the `version` neblla_get_file returned) so the edit fails with version_changed instead of overwriting a change made since you read the file. Whitespace and indentation count: copy oldText exactly as neblla_get_file returned it. Like neblla_upload_file, the result waits in the app's draft until neblla_promote({ action: "publish" }) (the next edit applies over it), and is one more version in neblla_versions once published (named by `message`). Text files only; to create a file, use neblla_upload_file.

baseVersion.description: The `version` neblla_get_file returned: the edit fails if the file changed since

edits.description: Applied in order, all or none

newText.description: What goes in its place ("" deletes it)

oldText.description: The exact text to replace (whitespace included)

replaceAll.description: Replace every place oldText appears, instead of requiring exactly one

message.description: A short note about this change; it names this version in neblla_versions

name: neblla_edit_file
